_comment: Datadog monitor for the auth-service 5xx error rate (Fase 4 req. 4, APM-side alert). Import via: POST /api/v1/monitor with DD-API-KEY/DD-APPLICATION-KEY, or manage with the datadog_monitor Terraform resource. The query uses OTel HTTP server spans ingested from the OTel Collector's datadog exporter; adjust the resource/span name filters to match what appears in your Datadog APM.
name: [ToggleMaster] auth-service 5xx error rate > 5%
message:
auth-service HTTP 5xx error rate has exceeded 5% over the last 5 minutes.

This will open a PagerDuty incident and notify the Discord channel. The in-cluster self-healing automation will also restart the deployment.

Runbook: https://github.com/nantius/desafio4-fiap-devops/blob/main/docs/runbooks/auth-5xx.md

@pagerduty-ToggleMaster @webhook-discord-incidents

options.escalation_message: auth-service 5xx still elevated — self-healing may not have resolved the issue; investigate manually.
